account: In the 2025 ITU entry, current as of June 2025, researchers at IIT Gandhinagar describe a framework that combines learned traffic prediction with classical routing optimization. They solve routing with integer linear programming and propose graph neural networks with deep reinforcement learning for large networks. The intended AI contribution is better anticipation of demand and more adaptive routing decisions. The authors give the status as an initial prototype. They state that the system will be simulated in Mininet to measure energy savings and throughput. No source reports operator energy savings attributable to AI. The ITU Innovate for Impact Interim Report 2026 contains no entry from IIT Gandhinagar on this framework.
